title: Asset can be permanently deleted in one tap with no confirmation, reason or record
status: Open - confirmed P0 by KK 9 Nov 2026; fix not started
evidence: src/routes/_authenticated/assets.tsx:49 (remove filters the asset out and saves); :110 (Delete button, no confirmation); found by 111-screen audit, verified by coordinator
required_fix: Replace Delete with a controlled Archive workflow: (1) no permanent deletion of financial asset records through the normal UI; (2) confirmation plus archival reason; (3) original record, documents, depreciation history, ownership and accounting references preserved; (4) who, when and why recorded; (5) Archived Assets view with authorised restore; (6) archiving does not change valuation, accounting balances or net worth; (7) disposal, sale, transfer, write-off and scrapping only through separate authorised accounting workflows; (8) same preservation principles for properties, investments and other financially significant records
track: UIX track (uix/screen-verification) with database track review for any SQL
tests_required: Accidental deletion impossible; archive with reason; restore; record and history preserved byte-identical; net worth and balances unchanged by archive and restore; disposal path separate
